The most satisfying place I've eaten recently.
Bukchon Soft Tofu Octopus was really delicious.

The spiciness of the octopus was just right, and I loved the soft, chewy texture without being tough.
The seasoning is not too spicy, so eating it with soft tofu provides the best balance. Soft tofu is warm and savory, so it's perfect for soothing the spicy taste.

The staff were so friendly that I enjoyed my meal and left.
The speed of ordering and food coming out was quick, and the table was neatly organized, so I could feel that they put a lot of thought into it overall.

The atmosphere is clean and quiet, so it's great to sit comfortably for a long time.
It's not a loud or hectic atmosphere, but it feels like you can focus on the taste in a simple way? It's okay to eat alone, or it would be nice to go with friends.

This restaurant made me think that the combination of soft tofu and octopus could go so well together.
I was very satisfied overall with the taste, atmosphere, and service.
I will definitely visit again!!!!!!!

reviews.text: This is a very old, long-established meat restaurant in Dongdaemun. It has a history of over 45 years, so it can be said to be a place you can trust and visit. The main building opens at 5 p.m., and the new building is open for lunch. There is a tower parking lot between the main building and the new building, so parking is easy. The lunch special is beef ribs, and the price is reasonable, but the food composition and quantity are satisfactory. There is also a variety of lunch menus, so customers mainly eat during lunch time. It was a popular place for company dinners, group gatherings, and meat customers in the evening. The beef ribs are from Australia, but they are of good quality, chewy, and savory, and the Jinkkot meat is from the United States, but the marbling is gorgeous, so soft and melts in your mouth. The Cheonggukjang was savory and rich in flavor, and the soybean paste stew was also excellent. And the cold noodles, although not home-made, were excellent in their own way.

reviews.author: 日本酒
reviews.text:
The best seolleongtang in Seoul

Seolleongtang generally boasts a thin broth and is sometimes considered a food from poor times. But this place, located in a back alley in central Seoul, is different.

It boasts a fairly thick broth, and the amount of toppings is also excellent for the price. Kimchi and radish radish kimchi are the type that uses appropriate msg and has a good acidity. The mung bean pancake is not comparable to famous stores, but it is not a bad accompaniment.

It is located at a similar level at half the price of Mapook, so it is worth a visit if it is not far away.

My close friend took me from Gangnam to 'Yeonnal Yeongil Naengmyeon' in Dongdaemun to buy me something really delicious.

The owner and his wife were Chinese people who could speak Korean, and they welcomed me very warmly as soon as they saw my brother.
Yeonnal Yeongil Naengmyeon has a variety of menus ranging from Korean to Chinese, so I entrusted the menu to my brother, who has been a regular for 20 years.

The food my brother ordered was guobao lu and cold noodles, a food from the Yeongil region of China.
The chewy and crispy texture of the guobao lu and the sweet and sour sauce combined to fill the mouth with flavor.

Yeongil Naengmyeon is the perfect combination of tangy noodles, cool broth, and ice-filled slush.

I wanted to try other foods, but I was so full after just eating the guobao soup and cold noodles that I couldn't eat any more.
My brother said that the fried dumplings sold here are really delicious.
Looking at the table next to me, I saw an elderly customer eating fried dumplings and a bottle of makgeolli in the bright afternoon.

As I am writing this review, I am looking at the photos I took back then, and my mouth is already watering just by looking at the photos.
I would like to visit again someday.

reviews.text: The food is delicious, and since it’s ssambap, I feel healthy. It's clean and has separate rooms, so it's great for gatherings. This is a cost-effective ssambap restaurant where you can eat various types of ssambap, including mackerel, bulgogi, and pork belly.

reviews.author: Hong Duik
reviews.text: The atmosphere is nice and there are rooms so it would be nice to take adults. The ssam is diverse and fresh, and most of all, the ssamjang is really delicious. Just adding ssamjang to rice and ssam is delicious. You can choose between brown rice, barley, and rice. The rice, soup, and ssam vegetables were self-service, and it was nice to be able to put as much as I wanted. The side dishes are also delicious. Grilled mackerel is too big to eat alone.

reviews.author: Dijju
reviews.text:
A place where you can eat a variety of ssam vegetables. The soybean paste at this place is amazing, and whether they make it themselves or get it from scratch, it is not salty and really enhances the flavor of the meat. There is a variety of self-service rice such as barley rice, brown rice, and white rice, and the blood sausage soup is self-serve, so you can eat meat with carbohydrates. Personally, I found the pork neck from Jeju to be more delicious than samgyeop.

★★★☆☆: No intention of revisiting, just so-so
★★★★☆: A house that is overall good but lacks cost-effectiveness, lacks service, or leaves something to be desired.
★★★★★: There is nothing to criticize, this is the house you want to go to if someone from out of town comes to visit.

reviews.author: australia
reviews.text:
It is located in the building behind Dongpyeonghwa Market, a clothing mall in Dongdaemun.  Because there are many merchants, the 8th and 9th floors are where restaurants are located.  There is a delicious restaurant serving coffee, bread, and pork cutlets, and Dachae is a meat restaurant that sells pork belly and pork neck as its main menu.  It's great to be able to use unlimited vegetables on your own.
In particular, the vegetables are very fresh, so it would be a good place for those who like vegetables.
Soybean paste stew is also worth eating.
If you go to Dongdaemun clothing store, stop by.
The scenery is also nice.
